scripts.check: npm run frontend:build && npm run typecheck && npm run backend:check
scripts.test: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:test && npm run test:integration
scripts.backend:dev: npm run frontend:build && cd backend && cargo run --bin backend -- ../config/yafm.config.yaml
scripts.backend:build: npm run frontend:build && cd backend && cargo build --release --bin backend
scripts.openapi:generate: cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin openapi -- api/openapi.yaml "$(node scripts/compute-version.mjs --release)" && npx prettier --write api/openapi.yaml
scripts.contract:generate: npm run openapi:generate && npm run client:generate
scripts.contract:check: npm run contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- api/openapi.yaml frontend/src/lib/api/generated/client.ts
